transcript.en: OK, Jim. You wanted to see me about your textile design project.
transcript.zh: 好的,吉姆。你是想和我谈谈你的纺织设计项目，是吧。

transcript.en: That's right. I've been looking at how a range of natural dyes can be used to colour fabrics like cotton and wool.
transcript.zh: 是的。我一直在研究如何使用一系列的天然染料来给像棉花和羊毛这样的织物上色。

transcript.en: Why did you choose that topic?
transcript.zh: 你为什么选择这个话题?

transcript.en: Well, I got a lot of useful ideas from the museum, you know, at that exhibition of textiles.
transcript.zh: 我从博物馆获得了很多有用的想法，你知道，在那个纺织品展上。

transcript.en: But I've always been interested in anything to do with colour
transcript.zh: 我一直对任何与颜色有关的东西都很感兴趣。

transcript.en: Years ago, I went to a carpet shop with my parents when we were on holiday in Turkey, and I remember all the amazing colours.
transcript.zh: 多年前，我们在土耳其度假时，我和父母一起去了一家地毯店。那些神奇的颜色一直留在我的脑海当中。

transcript.en: They might not all have been natural dyes.
transcript.zh: 它们可能并非都是天然染料。

transcript.en: Maybe not, but for the project I decided to follow it up.
transcript.zh: 也许不是，但为了这个项目，我决定跟进。

transcript.en: And I found a great book about a botanic garden in California that specialises in plants used for dyes.
transcript.zh: 我在加利福尼亚发现了一本关于植物园写得很棒的书，这本书是专门研究用于染料的植物。

transcript.en: OK. So, in your project, you had to include a practical investigation.
transcript.zh: 好的。所以，在你的项目中，你必须包含一个实际的调查。

transcript.en: Yeah. At first I couldn't decide on my variables.
transcript.zh: 是的。起初我还无法决定我的变量。

transcript.en: I was going to just look at one type of fibre for example, like cotton ...
transcript.zh: 我打算先去看一种纤维材料，例如棉花。

transcript.en: …and see how different types of dyes affected it?
transcript.zh: 然后看看不同类型的染料是如何影响它的?

transcript.en: Yes. Then I decided to include others as well, so I looked at cotton and wool and nylon.
transcript.zh: 是的，然后我决定也要去看看其它的材料，然后我就去看了棉花，羊毛和尼龙。

transcript.en: With just one type of dye?
transcript.zh: 只用一种染料吗?

transcript.en: Various types, including some that weren't natural, for comparison.
transcript.zh: 各种各样的类型，包括一些不是天然的材料，用于作比较。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So, I did the experiments last week. I used some ready-made natural dyes,
transcript.zh: 我上周就做了实验。我用了一些现成的天然染料，

transcript.en: I found a website which supplied them, they came in just a few days, but I also made some of my own.
transcript.zh: 我找到了一个提供这些染料的网站，它们在几天内就送来了，但我也自己做了一些。

transcript.en: That must have taken quite a bit of time.
transcript.zh: 那一定花了不少时间。

transcript.en: Yes, I'd thought it'd just be a matter of a teaspoon or so of dye, and actually that wasn't the case at all.
transcript.zh: 是的，我以为这只是一茶匙左右的染料，其实根本不是这样。

transcript.en: Like I was using one vegetable, beetroot, for a red dye, and I had to chop up a whole pile of it.
transcript.zh: 就像我用甜菜根做红色染料一样，我必须切碎一堆甜菜根。

transcript.en: So it all took longer than I'd expected. One possibility is to use food colourings.
transcript.zh: 所以这一切花费的时间比我预期的要长。另外一种可能是使用食品色素。

transcript.en: I did use one. That was a yellow dye, an artificial one.
transcript.zh: 我的确使用了一种，那是一种黄色的人造染料。

transcript.en: Tartrazine?
transcript.zh: 柠檬黄？

transcript.en: Yeah. I used it on cotton first It came out a great colour but when I rinsed the material, the colour just washed away.
transcript.zh: 是的。我先把它用在棉花上，颜色效果很好，但当我冲洗材料时，颜色就被冲走了。

transcript.en: I'd been going to try it out on nylon, but I abandoned that idea.
transcript.zh: 我本来打算用尼龙做的，但我放弃了这个想法。

transcript.en: Were you worried about health issues?
transcript.zh: 你担心健康问题吗?

transcript.en: I'd thought if it's a legal food colouring, it must be safe.
transcript.zh: 我想如果这是一种合法的食用色素，它一定是安全的。

transcript.en: Well, it can occasionally cause allergic reactions, I believe.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我相信它偶尔会引起过敏反应。

transcript.en: So what natural dyes did you look at?
transcript.zh: 所以你看了什么天然染料?

transcript.en: Well, one was turmeric. The colour's great, it's a really strong yellow.
transcript.zh: 嗯,一个是姜黄。那颜色效果很棒，是一种很浓的黄色。

transcript.en: It's generally used in dishes like curry.
transcript.zh: 它通常用在像咖喱这样的菜里头。

transcript.en: It's meant to be quite good for your health when eaten, but you might find it's not permanent when it's used as a dye - a few washes, and it's gone.
transcript.zh: 它对你的健康并无坏处，但是当它被用作染料时，你可能会发现它并不是永久的—只要洗几次，它就消失了。

transcript.en: Right. I used beetroot as a dye for wool. When I chop up beetroot to eat I always end up with bright red hands,
transcript.zh: 是的。我用甜菜根作了羊毛染料。当我切甜菜根吃的时候，

transcript.en: but the wool ended up just a sort of watery cream shade. Disappointing.
transcript.zh: 最后我总是满手鲜红，但是羊毛最后只是一种水状的奶油色。太令人失望了。

transcript.en: There's a natural dye called Tyrian purple. Have you heard of that?
transcript.zh: 有一种叫做泰尔紫的天然染料。你听说过吗?

transcript.en: Yes. It comes from a shellfish, and it was worn in ancient times but only by important people as it was so rare, I didn't use it.
transcript.zh: 是的。它来自一种贝类，在古代用作衣服染料，但只有大人物才能穿，因为它太稀有了，所以我没有使用它。

transcript.en: It fell out of use centuries ago, though one researcher managed to get hold of some recently.
transcript.zh: 它在几个世纪前就已经不再使用了，不过最近有一位研究人员设法找到了一些。

transcript.en: But that shade of purple can be produced by chemical dyes nowadays.
transcript.zh: 但是现在化学染料可以生产那种紫色。

transcript.en: Did you use any black dyes?
transcript.zh: 你用过黑色染料吗?

transcript.en: Logwood. That was quite complicated.
transcript.zh: 洋苏木，过程很复杂。

transcript.en: I had to prepare the fabric so the dye would take.
transcript.zh: 我得把布料准备好，这样子染料才会起作用。

transcript.en: I hope you were careful to wear gloves.
transcript.zh: 我希望你得小心一点，要带上手套。

transcript.en: Yes. I know the danger with that dye.
transcript.zh: 是的。我知道那种染料的危险。

transcript.en: Good. It can be extremely dangerous if it's ingested.
transcript.zh: 好的。如果它被摄入，这会非常危险。

transcript.en: Now, presumably you had a look at an insect-based dye? Like cochineal, for example?
transcript.zh: 现在，假设你已经看过昆虫染料? 例如,像胭脂红?

transcript.en: Yes. I didn't actually make that, I didn't have time to start crushing up insects to get the red colour and anyway they're not available here,
transcript.zh: 好的。实际上我并没有这样做，我没有时间去碾碎昆虫来得到这种红颜色。总之，这里没有这种颜色，

transcript.en: but I managed to get the dye quite easily from a website.
transcript.zh: 但是我很容易地就从网站上买到了这种染料。

transcript.en: But it cost a fortune. I can see why it's generally just used in cooking, and in small quantities.
transcript.zh: 但它花了一大笔钱。我明白为什么它通常只用于烹饪，而且数量很少了。

transcript.en: Yes, it's very effective, but that's precisely why it's not used as a dye.
transcript.zh: 是的，它非常有效，但这正是为什么它不被用作染料的原因。

transcript.en: I also read about using metal oxide.
transcript.zh: 我还读到过要用金属氧化物呢。

transcript.en: Apparently you can allow iron to rust while it's in contact with the fabric, and that colours it.
transcript.zh: 显然，当铁与织物接触时，它就能生锈，这样子它就变色。

transcript.en: Yes, that works well for dying cotton.
transcript.zh: 是的，这对染色棉很有效。

transcript.en: But you have to be careful as the metal can actually affect the fabric and so you can't expect to get a lot of wear out of fabrics treated in this way.
transcript.zh: 但是你必须小心，因为金属实际上会影响织物，所以你不能指望用这种方式处理许多织物衣物。

transcript.en: And the colours are quite subtle, not everyone likes them.
transcript.zh: 颜色很奇妙，但不是每个人都喜欢它们。

transcript.en: Anyway, it looks as if you've done a lot of work ...
transcript.zh: 不管怎样，看起来你好像做了很多工作……
